#[cfg(not(any(
    target_os = "freebsd",
    target_os = "netbsd",

    all(target_os = "wasi", target_env = "p2"),
)))]
pub fn sleep_until(deadline: crate::time::Instant) {
    use crate::time::Instant;

    let now = Instant::now();

    if let Some(delay) = deadline.checked_duration_since(now) {
        sleep(delay);
    }
}
